Class Entity

java.lang.Object
com.sfuparkingmayhem.game.Entity
Direct Known Subclasses:
MovingEntity, StaticEntity
public abstract class Entity extends Object
This class provides methods for different entities MovingEntity and StaticEntity to get x and y coordinates to be placed on the board, getting the entities' images and drawing them on the board.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Group 25

  • Method Details

    • getImage

      protected void getImage(String path)
      Gets the image of this Entity and throws IOExceptions e, if any, and prints out the error. Sets theImage of the Entity to the corresponding png in the resources directory.
      Parameters:
      path - The path name of the image to load in the resources folder.

    • drawTheImage

      protected void drawTheImage(Graphics graphics, ImageObserver io)
      Draws this Entity's png image, from resources directory, onto game board at this Entity's x and y coordinates. io will usually be passed as "this" since images are already loaded into resources directory.
      Parameters:
      graphics - helps draw this Entity's png on the board
      io - helps monitor the image being loaded for this Entity
